## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit (`feat: …`, `fix: …`, `docs: …`); release-please builds the changelog from it
- [ ] Every text a player sees exists in English and German
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] Schema changes come with a new migration; existing migrations are untouched
- [ ] No content copied from commercial rulebooks or games (texts, narration, artwork)
